entities.summary: Olha Vitaliivna Stefanishyna is a Ukrainian lawyer and civil servant. She became the deputy prime minister for European and Euro-Atlantic integration on 4 June 2020 to 16 July 2025. On 5 September 2024 Stefanishyna also became minister of justice; and had since then two ministries under her command. From August 2025, she is the Ambassador of Ukraine to the United States.
